en.headline: Fatal cycling accidents more than double in first half of 2026
en.dek: Police recorded nine cycling deaths in the first six months, a 125 per cent rise, and attributed the increase to riders ignoring signals and other risky behaviour.
body: Fatal cycling accidents in Hong Kong more than doubled in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period a year earlier, according to police figures released on Sunday.

Nine people died in bicycle-related crashes between January and June, up 125 per cent. Overall, there were 59 fatal traffic accidents that killed 63 people, a rise of more than 40 per cent from the first half of 2025.

A police spokesman said most cyclists involved tended to ignore traffic signals and road signs and failed to observe surrounding conditions carefully. Dangerous practices such as riding on pavements, carrying passengers illegally and riding side by side also raised the risk, the force said.

The New Territories North police region launched a cycling safety campaign on 1 August that combined street promotions, community talks and social-media outreach. Officers followed with enforcement action on 4 and 5 September, issuing nine warnings and 159 summonses over the two days.

zh.headline: 今年上半年致命單車意外急增逾倍 九人死亡
zh.dek: 警方指首六個月錄得九宗致命單車意外，按年升125%，認為與騎車人士漠視交通燈號及危險行為有關。
body: 警方周日公布，今年上半年致命單車意外較去年同期增加逾一倍，共有九人死亡，升幅達125%。
同期整體致命交通意外共59宗，造成63人死亡，較去年同期上升超過四成。
警方發言人表示，涉事單車騎士大多漠視交通燈號及道路標誌，亦未有小心留意周圍路面情況。在行人路上騎車、非法載客及並排行駛等危險行為，亦大幅增加意外風險。
新界北總區由8月1日起展開單車安全宣傳活動，其後於9月4日及5日進行執法行動，兩日共發出九張警告及159張傳票。
